product_metadata.title: 6ft Christmas Tinsel Tree with String Lights, Christmas Decorations Indoor, Pop up Christmas Tree with Stand Easy-Assembly, Big Xmas Decor for Bedrooms Office (Gold)
features: CHRISTMAS TREE WITH LIGHTS: This 6ft spiral tinsel artificial Christmas tree equipped with pentagram sparkling sequins and 3m USB plug warm LED lights. These sequins sparkle in the lights, looks festive and pretty.

POP UP DESIGN: Features the pull-up design, only takes 2 minutes to assemble and no need of any tools. You can take off and fold it in the package easily for next holiday's repeatedly use. TIPS: If it is hooked, please adjust it slightly.
PREMIUM MATERIAL: We use the highest quality PVC and metal to construct this artificial Christmas tree to improve durability and prolong products' service life.
SMALL FOOTPRINT: Our small christmas tree takes up little area, so it can be used in any spaces. It is perfect for samll apartment, bedroom, living room, dining room and other small spaces.
WIDE APPLICATION: Perfect gift for your families and friends. Also the best choice for decorating birthday, Christmas, baby shower, welcome party, wedding, celebration, anniversary, graduation, etc.
description: To balance the aesthetic, put one Fireplace Christmas Tree on each side of the fireplace mantel.
With this kind of artificial tree, every day is Christmas!
Color: Gold, Red, Silver, Green and Multicolor (Choose one)
Light Modes: Combination, in Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Chaing/ Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/ Flash, Steady on.
The button on the plug can control different lighting modes.
If you turn on the lights in the dark, the pop up Christmas tree looks prettier.
If you use it outdoors(such as outdoor steps, gardens...), please fix the base of the tree with heavy things, so as not to knocked down by wind or pets.
If you want it to be more plentiful, you can hang some gadgets such as Christmas socks.
Dense branches ensure a full appearance
Rugged iron frame for your long-term use
Partitioned structure for quick installation disassembly and storage
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us!
